name: Bug report
about: Something doesn't work or the game stops

**What happened?**
What you were doing, and what went wrong (crash, error message, black screen, wrong controls...).

**Log file**
Please attach `ib3rt.log` from the game folder (next to `Infinity Blade III.exe`). It is rewritten every time the game starts, so grab it right after the problem.

**Your setup**
- Windows version:
- Graphics card:
- Version of this port (see the release you downloaded):
- Settings you changed in the launcher (if any):

Please don't attach or link game files or `.ipa` files.
